asked.item: Why the follow gate was skipped (log: confirmed follower)
Same test account passed the gate last week on an old automation
Test account never gets the follow question

verdict.reason: The pages state that automations published after November 10, 2026 skip the follow gate for a contact confirmed as a follower in the last 30 days, and they say how to test the gate.

steps.text: On automations published after November 10, 2026, a contact Blotato confirmed as a follower within the last 30 days skips the follow gate.
Blotato skips the gate when the contact passed a follow gate on the same connected account in an earlier run, and your message sends right away with no gate message and no check.
To see the gate message while testing, comment or message from an account that has not passed a follow gate in the last 30 days.
